'N lazy skill candidates are indexed' (scope.ts:108-115) is the cheapest transferable unit of the lazy-catalog design; ~15 tokens/turn buys discovery-depth awareness.

keyFindings.reason: Orchestrator emits 'No matching skills found...' (index.ts:687-696); advisor's null brief makes abstention indistinguishable from outage (render.ts:409-412).

keyFindings.mechanism: pull recovery beside push: name advisor_recommend in the directives-only fallback
keyFindings.reason: The orchestrator proves a model can drive retrieval when handed a tool name (index.ts:596-650); the advisor's fail_open currently leaves zero in-turn recovery.

keyFindings.mechanism: budget enforcement (deadline race) around the Pi in-process advisor call
keyFindings.reason: The Pi hook awaits handleClaudeUserPromptSubmit with no race (prompt-advisor.ts:243-250); the 2500ms budget is self-reported, not enforced. Mimo lineage concurs (F9-2).

Three adapters dedup the constant directive tail (user-prompt-submit.ts:303-345, prompt-advisor.ts:129-152, plugin splitDirectiveBrief) but no delivered-byte measurement exists; it is the prerequisite for every cost claim.

Orchestrator's +200 name-exact guarantees top-1 (search.ts:26); advisor's exact mention scores 1.0 inside a 0.42 lane (explicit.ts:317-321) so a fused competitor can outrank a named skill. Gate to invocation shapes to avoid prose false-pins.

keyFindings.mechanism: soft scope preference (family/hub prior) with global pool open
keyFindings.reason: Advisor has no per-context scope (only the static denylist route-exclusions.ts:59-99); a fusion prior mirrors the orchestrator's bounded-fallback-never-changes-scope discipline.

keyFindings.mechanism: pull-surface output shape: <=5 default / <=8 max, <=160-char descriptions
keyFindings.reason: Orchestrator's bounded result contract (search.ts:46, index.ts:590,600-609, config.ts:45,138-139) is the right shape for any advisor pull tool; the pushed brief is already tighter.

keyFindings.mechanism: depends_on derivation assist borrowing conservative body-scan + negation guard
keyFindings.reason: Advisor edge store is populated but sparse (depends_on 3/15 nodes); the orchestrator's five-pattern detector with negation guard (dependencies.ts:8-38) fits beside detect-inbound-enhances.
Orchestrator reports bundle.missing/bundle.cycles (index.ts:736-746); advisor's trust surface could carry edge-store health for operators.

keyFindings.mechanism: whole-brief bound: count (never clip) the constant directive block
keyFindings.reason: Directives are appended after capText (render.ts:435-440) so the real worst case is ~138 tokens not 80; count them in delivered-byte accounting.

keyFindings.mechanism: truncate-and-keep ranking metadata instead of drop-to-null at 512 chars
keyFindings.reason: Advisor nulls over-length metadata (metadata-sanitizer.ts:9-11,34); orchestrator keeps bounded prefixes (catalog.ts:7-13). Partial signal beats none.

keyFindings.reason: Pi hook deep-imports a dist path (prompt-advisor.ts:47-50); a contract test makes dist-layout drift fail loudly instead of silently degrading to advisorFailed.
